component.name: Calendar
component.summary: A calendar for the COSMIC Desktop

description.p: Calendar is a modern, intuitive calendar application built for the COSMIC Desktop Environment. It provides a clean interface for managing your events and appointments with support for multiple calendar sources including local calendars and CalDAV.

ul.li: Month, week, and day views
Support for multiple calendars with custom colors
Import and export iCalendar (.ics) files
Local calendar storage
CalDAV synchronization support
Responsive design for desktop and mobile
Native COSMIC integration
The Flatpak build now exposes the tray icon directory to the host, so the system tray icon renders on COSMIC (it previously registered but drew blank)
The Add CalDAV Account dialog now has an "iCloud" preset button that fills in caldav.icloud.com and shows guidance about using an app-specific password
A new "Mini Calendar" tray menu item opens a small popup window with the same compact month grid as the sidebar
The mini calendar (sidebar and popup) can now show ISO week numbers, controlled by the existing week-numbers setting
Edits and deletes now send an If-Match ETag, so a server-side change since the last sync rejects the write (412) instead of silently clobbering it
On a conflict the app shows a desktop notification and re-syncs the calendar to the latest server version
Fixed week-view flicker on mouse/keyboard input (hover handlers now attach only during an active drag)
Fixed flicker when restoring the window from the tray/dock (opaque background instead of compositor blur)
Dock/systray clicks and file/URL opens now activate the running instance instead of spawning a second one
Month, week, and day calendar views
Multiple calendar support with custom colors
Local calendar storage
CalDAV synchronization
Responsive layout for desktop and mobile
